complexity_ledger.narrative:
Full record: specs/results/scorecards/cut-the-apparatus/CA-01/RESULT.md. Measured inventory: .../CA-01/INVENTORY.md. R1 demonstration: .../CA-01/R1-demonstration.txt. Cost with its basis named: .../CA-01/COST.md. Escalated diffs: .../CA-01/PROPOSED-DIFFS.md.
WHAT THE MACHINE-CHECKED CORE ABOVE CANNOT EXPRESS, and it is the whole ticket.
The complexity delta is zero and the ticket is still net-additive: +182 Python lines in `examples/validation/`, `scripts/` unchanged, card unchanged at 6,281 bytes. The model did not move because the thing measured is not in the model. What CA-01 measured is what the HARNESS puts in a dispatched agent's context before it reads anything, and no TLA+ variable can see that.
THE MEASUREMENT. Four agents dispatched, asked only to report their own pre-read context verbatim and what they rejected. Three of four received the operator's `MEMORY.md` in full plus the five most recent commit subject lines before any tool call; one (`Explore`) received neither. That CORRECTS `SV-05-DF-02`'s "4 of 4" to a tier and narrows a published figure. The half that survives is the half that matters: it reaches the agent types this project actually uses for judges.
MEASURED ALTERNATIVES, each refused with a reason. (1) Ship `Explore` as the blinding mechanism. Cheapest result available; would
    have closed this ticket with ZERO new apparatus and no `GOAL-apparatus-cut`
    regression. Refused: one observation, one harness version, undocumented
    behaviour, and the `Explore` arm shared the leaking session so cwd does not
    explain it. `SV-05-DF-01` is this project's own precedent for what that bet
    costs -- a version flag that served the wrong card and was accepted.
(2) `claude --bare`. The harness's own switch, documented to skip auto-memory,
    hooks and CLAUDE.md discovery in one flag -- strictly better than what
    shipped. Unusable here: it forces `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` or an `apiKeyHelper`
    and never reads OAuth or the keychain, and no key is set. `CA-01-DF-02`.
(3) `--safe-mode`. Plausible, keeps normal auth, NOT documented to disable
    auto-memory. Not measured, so nothing is claimed in either direction.
(4) Write the instrument in shell. The `GOAL-apparatus-cut` command counts
    `*.py`, so shell would have cost zero MEASURED lines for identical
    function. Refused as gaming the denominator; written in Python and priced.
(5) Suppress the SessionStart hook to clear `CA-01-DF-01`. Would have turned a
    blocking finding into a clean pass in one settings change. Refused: it is
    the operator's machine, the charter forbids applying such a change, and it
    was never measured to work.

THE FINDING THE CORE CANNOT CARRY. Blindness to the operator's CONCLUSIONS is achievable and is proven on real subjects -- `check` REFUSES a fresh repo-rooted `claude -p` (26 indicators) and a judge-shaped subagent (25), and PASSES a neutral cell. Blindness to the project's IDENTITY is NOT achievable with this harness: the arm that passed still received the SessionStart hook naming `spec-double-compiler` and `test-graph`, and the skill listing describing the TLA+ spec-double pipeline. Filed `CA-01-DF-01`, BLOCKING, because it decides what `CA-08` may call its rounds.
R1 EARNED ITS KEEP HERE. Run against its first real subject the instrument derived ZERO memory needles -- the ticket worktree has no memory slug while the primary checkout it branched from has all 19 files -- and would have returned a pass carried only by literal block labels. Fixed with `--memory` and a `WEAK PASS` warning, and written up rather than quietly corrected.
NOT DONE, DELIBERATELY: no memory file and no skill was edited. `MEMORY.md`'s sha256 and mtime are unchanged; two diffs are escalated instead. `skill-manager sync` was never run. The inherited `PA-01` spec-unit red and all 12 suite reds were left unrepaired and attributed rather than fixed.

refinement.detail:
Searched, found none, and the reason is that this ticket changes no model. CA-01's assignment declares `model_delta_expectation: none expected`; its ticket-local `current` and `desired` are byte-identical (`diff -rq` clean), and `specs/current/` is untouched on this branch. The measured delta agrees: `direction=zero (vs SV-04)`. There is no added representation to refine and no increase to justify.
What the ticket ships is a 182-line instrument under `examples/validation/instruments/` and two documents. None of it is reachable from Internal.tla or External.tla, none of it declares an action, and none of it is a spec double. The one structure it adds to a MODELLED surface is a `[[instrument]]` row in `instruments.toml`, which the registry's own enumeration test requires of any executable under a declared instrument root -- omitting it would have been a new suite red, not a simplification.
REFINEMENT WAS CONSIDERED IN THE OTHER DIRECTION AND REFUSED, which is worth recording because it would have removed all 182 lines. `CA-01-DF-04` measured that the auto-memory leak is keyed to the SESSION CWD and that no ticket worktree of this repository carries a memory slug at all -- so a judge dispatched from a worktree-rooted session would already miss the auto-memory with no instrument whatsoever. That arm was NOT measured by this ticket, so it is filed as a deferred finding for a successor rather than shipped as a refinement on an untested premise. Applying it here would have been trading a demonstrated path for a plausible one.

summary: Blindness measured, not assumed: 3 of 4 dispatched agents received the operator's auto-memory and the five most recent commit subject lines before any tool call, correcting SV-05-DF-02's '4 of 4' to a tier. A memory-free path is proven on real subjects (2 REFUSED, 1 PASS) and its residual impossibility is stated as blocking finding CA-01-DF-01: blindness to our conclusions is achievable, blindness to our identity is not. No memory file and no skill edited; two diffs escalated. Costs 182 Python lines in examples/validation/.

The cost is stated plainly, including if blindness is unachievable.
No memory file and no skill is edited; any such change is a proposed diff and an escalation.
Every dispatched agent is asked what it REJECTED and the answers are recorded.

ticket.objective: GOAL 03, AND IT LANDS BEFORE ANY JUDGED ROUND IN THIS EPIC. The owner's words: 'make sure the memory doesn't leak in, because that's been a killer.' SV-05 measured 4 of 4 blind agents disclosing UNPROMPTED that the operator's auto-memory and the environment block were in their context before they read anything; one quoted MEMORY.md verbatim, naming the exact prior on the exact question a D3 judge is asked. IT ARRIVES WITH NO TOOL CALL, so no forbidden-reading list in any dispatch can reach it, and NOTHING A DISPATCH SAYS REMOVES A BLOCK THE HARNESS INJECTS FIRST. THREE THINGS, IN ORDER. FIRST, ESTABLISH WHAT A DISPATCHED AGENT ACTUALLY RECEIVES -- auto-memory, environment block, CLAUDE.md, session hooks, skill listings, anything else -- BY MEASURING IT, NOT BY ASSUMING IT: dispatch agents that are asked only to report their own pre-read context verbatim, and record what comes back. SECOND, BUILD A DISPATCH PATH THAT DEMONSTRABLY CARRIES NONE OF THE OPERATOR'S CONCLUSIONS, and PROVE IT THE SAME WAY -- fresh agents through the new path, asked what they received, with their answers recorded verbatim. Inspecting configuration is not proof; R1 requires a demonstrated failing input on a real subject, so SHOW THE PATH REFUSING TO LEAK ON A CASE THAT LEAKED BEFORE. THIRD, SAY WHAT IT COSTS. IF BLINDNESS CANNOT BE ACHIEVED WITH THIS HARNESS, THAT IS A FINDING ABOUT THE WHOLE PROGRAMME and it must be stated rather than worked around, together with a contamination note that can be printed beside every number the way SV-01-DF-01 did. DO NOT SOLVE THIS BY EDITING THE OPERATOR'S MEMORY SILENTLY AND CALLING THE PROBLEM GONE -- the record must say what every past round carried, and any change to a memory file or a skill is PROPOSED AS A DIFF AND ESCALATED, never applied. ASK EVERY AGENT YOU DISPATCH WHAT IT REJECTED.
